calendarDiscovery.crawlerNotes: Florida Franklin district 19 is based in Eastpoint and uses Eastern Time. The local PDF matches the current district Calendar-page download by SHA-256. File/metadata title says updated 6.22.26, but no printed approval/revision date is supplied; do not infer Board adoption or publication from that title or the June 24 PDF creation time. Green early release applies to October 16 and May 27; no dismissal time is printed. The online October 16 parade slot is 2-3 p.m., not a pickup-time source. Peach Veterans Day/MLK program entries are ordinary school dates, not closures. Purple planning days are student-free schedule entries; retain their derived no-class normalization. There are eight in-year PD/planning days. Keep unnamed September 4/April 19 closures generic. Exact named ranges stay separate from adjacent staff days: Thanksgiving November 23-27, Christmas/New Year December 21-January 1, spring March 15-19 and Easter March 26-29. Return dates are December 1 after Thanksgiving and explicitly January 5 after Christmas. March 22-25 are attendance days between spring and Easter breaks. Seniors finish May 14, recognition is May 25, and May 27 combines non-senior last day, grading end, early release and graduation. The regular non-senior date grid yields 170 planned attendance weekdays = 208 - 38; no annual total or hurricane-reserve list is printed. Retain all seven assessment ranges as assignment windows, not daily exams or attendance, including endpoints outside ordinary class dates. June 3 final report cards are a student/family reporting event. FTE funding markers and staff-only summer/post-planning are excluded; June 2-30 summer school is separate and explicitly Monday-Thursday. No later attendance change or dismissal clock time was verified in accessible district materials; dynamic news articles and the campus homepage were not fully retrievable. Separate charter/adult-education schedules and future school years have not been verified. schoolAgePopulation is an unset ranking placeholder, not enrollment.

editorialSummary.heading: Seafood Festival days off, longer breaks and senior milestones
highlights: School is closed November 5–6 for the Seafood Festival and May 7 for Estuaries' Day.
Students return December 1 after Thanksgiving and January 5 after Christmas/New Year.
Seniors finish May 14, with recognition May 25 and graduation May 27.
paragraphs: At Franklin County School, students are off November 5–6, 2026, for the Seafood Festival and May 7, 2027, for Estuaries' Day. They also have September 4–8 off: September 4 is listed as No School, followed by the weekend, Labor Day and a teacher professional development day.

Thanksgiving break runs November 23–27, but November 30 is a teacher professional development day, so students return December 1. Christmas/New Year break officially runs December 21–January 1, while teacher planning days on December 18 and January 4 extend the time off until January 5. Spring break is March 15–19, followed by regular classes March 22–25 and a separate Good Friday/Easter break March 26–29.

Seniors finish regular classes May 14, with recognition May 25 and graduation May 27. May 27 is also the last day for other students and has early release; the other listed early-release date is October 16 for Homecoming. The district's PDF does not give dismissal or ceremony times. Testing windows and the June 3 final report-card date do not add regular school days.

about.dataSource: The supplied one-page PDF matches the current file linked as 2026-27 FCSD School Calendar on the district Calendar page. Its visible heading identifies Franklin County School District, with Franklin County School listed below. The text table, month-grid colors, grading symbols and assessment-date panel were reviewed together.
about.processing: The current official and local files have identical SHA-256 hashes. Green means Early Release: both October 16 and May 27 have that marking, although only the homecoming row spells it out. The May 27 oval and triangle also establish the last student day and fourth-nine-weeks endpoint; graduation shares that canonical occurrence. Seniors have a separate May 14 class endpoint and May 25 recognition milestone. Peach entries are school programs/functions: November 11 Veterans Day Program and January 15 MLK Program do not create closures. Purple planning marks establish the student-free baseline on the four Teacher Planning Day dates; their normalized no-class status is derived from the staff-day schedule rather than a literal No students label. Explicit PD/no-students entries supply the other four in-year staff days. The September 4 and April 19 unnamed closures retain generic No School names. November 5-6 and March 26-29 are explicit continuous closure ranges. Thanksgiving November 23-27 stays separate from November 30 PD. Christmas/New Year December 21-January 1 stays separate from December 18 and January 4 planning, with an explicit January 5 return. March 12 planning does not change the official March 15-19 spring range; March 22-25 remain class dates before the separate Easter break. The regular non-senior baseline contains 208 weekdays minus 38 no-class weekdays, giving 170 calculated attendance weekdays. No printed annual total or hurricane make-up reserve list is supplied. All seven assessment ranges are stored as windows with no daily attendance or campus-status assertion: their endpoints can overlap holidays, pre-planning or the May 28 staff day without changing regular class dates. June 3 report cards are retained as final reporting. FTE funding-count markers, July 3, August pre-planning, May 28 staff work, May 31 after the student year and June 1 summer planning are omitted. Summer school June 2-30 is explained separately with its explicit Monday-Thursday scope, without adding every date to the regular-year calendar. The metadata title references an update on June 22, 2026, but that is not a printed Board adoption or revision statement; the June 24 PDF creation timestamp is also not an approval date.
about.updates: Checked the current Calendar page and matching PDF, district homepage, available All News listing, October calendar entries and targeted official-site searches on October 19, 2026. The online calendar confirms the October 16 homecoming parade, but its 2:00-3:00 p.m. event slot is not a published dismissal time. No later attendance change or current dismissal clock time was verified. The September 19 Homecoming news item opens a shared page anchor rather than a readable full article in the text reader, and the school homepage was not retrievable, so this is not an exhaustive review of dynamic school notices.
about.disclaimer: Use school notices for pickup times, program participation, individual testing appointments and senior ceremony details. The 170-day calculation describes the regular non-senior schedule, not senior attendance or summer school. Confirm any charter or adult-education calendar separately.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school in Franklin County, Florida, in 2026?
faqs.answer: Franklin County School in Eastpoint begins classes Tuesday, August 11, 2026. Orientation is scheduled for Thursday, August 6.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Franklin County, Florida, in 2027?
faqs.answer: Thursday, May 27, 2027, is the last regular school day for students other than seniors, with early release. Seniors finish regular classes Friday, May 14.

faqs.question: When is orientation for the 2026-2027 school year?
faqs.answer: Orientation is Thursday, August 6, 2026. The district calendar does not list a start time or grade-specific sessions, so check Franklin County School announcements for those details.

faqs.question: When is Franklin County School's open house in 2026?
faqs.answer: Open House is Thursday, October 22, 2026. The annual district calendar lists the date but not the event time. Check the school for visiting hours and classroom arrangements.

faqs.question: Why do some Franklin County school calendars show different October 2026 dates?
faqs.answer: The current district calendar lists Homecoming early release on October 16, teacher planning on October 19, and Open House on October 22, 2026. An earlier district PDF listed October 23, October 12, and October 15, respectively. For the latest dates, use the PDF linked on the district's official Calendar page and check school announcements.

faqs.question: Does Franklin County School have a fall break in 2026?
faqs.answer: The district does not label a separate fall break in its 2026-2027 calendar. October 19 is a teacher planning day without regular classes, and November 5–6 are no-school dates for the Seafood Festival.

faqs.question: When is Franklin County School Homecoming in 2026?
faqs.answer: The district's calendar marks Friday, October 16, 2026, as Homecoming with early release. The online events calendar lists Homecoming-themed activities during October 12–16 and a Homecoming Parade on October 16 from 2 to 3 p.m. The parade time is not the student dismissal time; check school notices for pickup arrangements.

faqs.question: Which days have early release in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Friday, October 16, 2026, for Homecoming and Thursday, May 27, 2027, the last school day, are marked for early release. Both count as school days. The other grading-period end dates—October 9, December 17 and March 11—are not marked for early release.

faqs.question: What time is early dismissal on Homecoming or the last day of school?
faqs.answer: The district's annual calendar does not give a dismissal time for October 16 or May 27. Check Franklin County School's pickup and bus notices for the time on each date. The Homecoming parade schedule should not be used as a dismissal schedule.

faqs.question: Which days are students off around Labor Day 2026?
faqs.answer: There are no classes Friday, September 4; Monday, September 7, for Labor Day; or Tuesday, September 8, for teacher professional development. Including the weekend, students have five consecutive days off and return Wednesday, September 9.

faqs.question: Is there school during the Seafood Festival in November 2026?
faqs.answer: No. The district calendar closes school Thursday, November 5, and Friday, November 6, 2026, for the Seafood Festival. Students have November 5–8 off when the weekend is included and return Monday, November 9. These are school closure dates, not the festival's published operating hours.

faqs.question: Does Franklin County School close for Veterans Day in 2026?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists a Veterans' Day Program on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, rather than a no-school holiday. It remains a school day on the published calendar.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break, and when do students return?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break is November 23–27, 2026. Monday, November 30, is a teacher professional development day with no students, so classes resume Tuesday, December 1—not November 30. Including the weekends, students have November 21–30 off.

faqs.question: When is winter break, and when do students return in January 2027?
faqs.answer: Christmas/New Year break runs December 21, 2026–January 1, 2027. December 18 and January 4 are separate teacher planning days, giving students 18 consecutive days without classes from December 18 through January 4. They return Tuesday, January 5.

faqs.question: Is Franklin County School closed on Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, January 18, 2027, is a no-school holiday. The Martin Luther King Jr. Program on Friday, January 15, is a school event, not a closure. Classes resume Tuesday, January 19.

faqs.question: When is Presidents' Day break in February 2027?
faqs.answer: School is closed Monday, February 15, for Presidents' Day and Tuesday, February 16, for teacher professional development. Students return Wednesday, February 17, giving them four consecutive days off when the preceding weekend is included.

faqs.question: When is spring break in 2027, and when do students return?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 15–19, 2027. Friday, March 12, is a separate teacher planning day without classes, extending the time off to March 12–21, including weekends. Students return Monday, March 22.

faqs.question: Is Good Friday/Easter break the same as spring break?
faqs.answer: No. Spring break is March 15–19, while Good Friday/Easter break is March 26–29, 2027. Students are scheduled to attend classes March 22–25 between the two breaks and return Tuesday, March 30, after Easter.

faqs.question: Are April 16 and April 19, 2027, both no-school days?
faqs.answer: Yes. Friday, April 16, is a teacher professional development day with no students. Monday, April 19, is separately listed as No School, without a reason specified. Together with the weekend, students have four days off and return Tuesday, April 20.

faqs.question: Is there school on Estuaries' Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Franklin County School's calendar lists Friday, May 7, 2027, as Estuaries' Day—No School. Regular classes resume Monday, May 10.

faqs.question: Which teacher workdays are days off for students in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Students have no regular classes on September 8, October 19, November 30 and December 18, 2026, or January 4, February 16, March 12 and April 16, 2027. These are teacher planning or professional development days, separate from the named school holidays.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school for seniors in 2027?
faqs.answer: Friday, May 14, 2027, is the last regular class day for seniors at Franklin County School. It is earlier than the May 27 last day for other students. Senior recognition and graduation take place later in May.

faqs.question: When is Senior Recognition at Franklin County School in 2027?
faqs.answer: Senior Recognition is Tuesday, May 25, 2027. Seniors finish regular classes May 14, and graduation follows May 27. The annual calendar does not list a recognition ceremony time.

faqs.question: When is Franklin County School graduation in 2027?
faqs.answer: Graduation is scheduled for Thursday, May 27, 2027. Seniors finish regular classes May 14, with Senior Recognition on May 25. The district's annual calendar does not provide the graduation time or guest arrangements.

faqs.question: When do the four nine-week grading periods end?
faqs.answer: The four grading-period end dates are October 9 and December 17, 2026, followed by March 11 and May 27, 2027. May 27 is also the last day of school and has early release. The other three dates are not marked for early dismissal.

faqs.question: When are report cards scheduled for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Report cards are listed for October 15, 2026; January 7, March 25 and June 3, 2027. June 3 comes after the May 27 last day of regular classes and is not another student attendance day.

faqs.question: When are the Florida FAST progress-monitoring windows?
faqs.answer: The district lists FAST PM 1 for August 3–September 25, 2026; PM 2 for November 30, 2026–January 22, 2027; and PM 3 for April 12–May 28, 2027. These are assessment windows, not daily testing schedules. The May 28 endpoint does not extend the regular school year.

faqs.question: When are FAST and EOC retakes scheduled?
faqs.answer: FAST/EOC retake windows are September 8–October 2 and November 30–December 18, 2026, followed by May 3–28, 2027. The school will confirm which students need retakes and their assigned testing dates.

faqs.question: When is the writing assessment window in 2027?
faqs.answer: The published writing assessment window is March 29–April 9, 2027. March 29 is also a no-school date during Easter break. The window does not make that date a regular school day or mean every student tests on that day.

faqs.question: When does summer school run in 2027?
faqs.answer: The district lists summer school from June 2–30, 2027, Monday through Thursday. It is a separate program after the regular school year. The annual calendar does not provide daily session times or individual enrollment arrangements.

faqs.question: How many school days are scheduled for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The regular non-senior calendar works out to 170 planned student attendance weekdays: 208 weekdays from August 11 through May 27, minus 38 no-school weekdays. This is calculated from the published dates, not an official annual total printed in the district PDF. It does not describe the senior or summer-school schedule.

faqs.question: Does this calendar apply to Apalachicola Bay Charter School?
faqs.answer: This page follows the district calendar for Franklin County School in Eastpoint. The dates have not been independently verified for Apalachicola Bay Charter School or the adult-education program. Check those programs' own calendars before using these dates.

faqs.question: Where can I get the official printable school calendar and find updates?
faqs.answer: The Franklin County School District Calendar page links its 2026-27 school calendar PDF. Check district and Franklin County School announcements for later changes, dismissal times, transportation updates and graduation details.
